Audio! SD-1 Superdrive Published on June 2, 2024 Audio! Audio! boost / preamp distortion overdrive pedal Information Audio! Audio! Audio! Audio! Superdrive Type: Boost/Overdrive/Distortion Controls: Level: Adjusts the output volume of the pedal. Presence: Alters the high-end frequencies, adding sparkle and clarity. Gain: Controls the amount of overdrive/distortion. Hi: Adjusts the high-frequency EQ. Mid: Adjusts the mid-frequency EQ. Lo: Adjusts the low-frequency EQ. Toggle Switches: Clipping Diodes: Selects between different clipping diodes: Red LEDs: Provides a louder, more open sound with less compression. MOSFETs: Offers a balanced, smooth clipping characteristic. Silicon 1n4148: Delivers tighter, more compressed distortion. Clipping Mode: Selects between different clipping modes: Clean Boost: Adds volume without significant distortion. Soft-Clipping: Produces a smoother, more natural overdrive. Hard Clipping: Results in a more aggressive, distorted tone. Features: Buffers: Bypassable input/output buffers driven by a high-quality Burr Brown OPA2134 op amp, ensuring minimal signal degradation and enhanced tonal clarity. Versatility: Capable of functioning as a clean boost, overdrive, or distortion pedal, making it suitable for a wide range of musical styles and applications. Origins: The Superdrive began as a clone of the Earthquaker Devices Talons overdrive, but it has been significantly modified and enhanced with additional features by Audio! Audio! to provide greater flexibility and tonal options. Summary: The Audio! Audio! Superdrive is a versatile and high-quality pedal designed for guitarists seeking a wide range of overdrive and distortion tones. With its comprehensive EQ section, multiple clipping options, and high-fidelity buffers, it stands out as a flexible and powerful tool for shaping your guitar sound. Whether you need a subtle boost, smooth overdrive, or aggressive distortion, the Superdrive can deliver with precision and clarity.
